reading_caveat: Dataset names are categorical positions, not a proportionally spaced numerical training-size axis. Lines connect only the three tested dataset totals. Forward panels use visible nonzero lower axis limits; joint hits use 0..100%, so exact small differences should be read from the bound CSV. Error bars are sample SD across three seeds, not confidence intervals. Training and validation populations both change. COMMON_PROXY is the original D100k seed20260713 F and is not independent of that historical arm; these plots do not establish a physical ranking.
scope: Visual review of the two newly closed dataset three-seed PNGs and reading their completed mean/SD tables only. Existing parent-verified transport and input/output bindings were reused, not rerun. No repeated CSV replot or whole-project QA.
